item.title: Rallying Cry – October 31, 2026
item.description: From a cognitive scientist memorizing a poem in minutes using ancient Greek techniques to Singapore’s Wolbachia project covering over half its households, plus a heartwarming tale of a barber finding a new home and nations uniting to restore biodiversity goals, today’s news is full of clever solutions and progress.
